title: 上海高考翻译背诵-66-25一模松江

items.zh: 不如我们带上新买的望远镜去赏月吧!
items.en: How about taking the newly bought telescope to enjoy the moon?

items.zh: 这种布料用棉线编织而成,很有民族特色。
items.en: Woven from cotton thread, the fabric is rich in ethnic flair/charm/characteristics.

items.zh: 天气不好,孩子们心心念念的露天音乐会只能推迟两周举行。
items.en: Due to the bad weather, the open-air concert that the children have been looking forward to has to be postponed for two weeks.

items.zh: 这位工匠在筷子制作方面的贡献无人能及,这项荣誉非他莫属。
items.en: No one can match this craftsman’s contribution to chopstick-making, so he truly deserves the honor.
